description: Optical harvest dates (kernelag.features peak_doy, cut_doy) expressed in thermal time: corn modified GDD in degC-days (base 10, cap 30, both temperatures clipped to 10-30), cumulative from May 1, from Open-Meteo archive daily Tmax/Tmin (ERA5-Land, ERA5 fallback) at each 10 km cell centre. gdd_peak_to_cut = GDD(cut) - GDD(peak); gdd_share_at_cut = GDD(cut) / GDD(May 1-Oct 31). Descriptive only: gdd_at_cut, gdd_season_may_oct. No benchmark rule: the research thresholds are relative to black layer, which no input here observes.
units: degC-days (1 degC-day = 1.8 degF-day); gdd_share_at_cut is unitless
